subject.title: feat(ui): add standalone operator approval links

question: Should OpenClaw permanently reserve `${controlUiBasePath}/approve/{id}` ahead of plugin HTTP routes, accepting that an existing plugin using that one-segment namespace would stop receiving those requests?
rationale: The route can be implemented mechanically, but only maintainers can accept the upgrade and plugin compatibility boundary created by claiming it in core.

options.title: Reserve the namespace
options.body: Accept `/approve/{id}` as a core-owned route, document the reservation, and merge after the deterministic defects and proof gap are fixed.

options.title: Use a collision-resistant path
options.body: Move the document beneath a more explicitly core-owned prefix before merge to avoid shadowing existing plugin routes.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Keep this PR open until the permanent plugin HTTP namespace policy is decided.

recommendation.title: Reserve the namespace
recommendation.body: Accept `/approve/{id}` as a core-owned route, document the reservation, and merge after the deterministic defects and proof gap are fixed.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the approval architecture and the route reservation requiring the compatibility decision.
